name: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
summary: A customer awaits one Iridescent Hammer, with delivery and payment details set down in a writ. Its transferable mark lets the holder complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The customer asks for one Iridescent Hammer. Bring the writ to complete the exchange at the marked location.

faq.answer: One Iridescent Hammer is what the customer wants.
The writ gives the delivery details, and the location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Does the writ need to be with me?
faq.answer: Yes. Keep the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.q: Can someone else use the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ is marked as transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ includes payment information.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
